boss.text: Your shadows cannot stand against the sun!

danger.text: A worthy foe at last! The gods are watching!

down.text: Rise! The sun does not let its champions fall!

down2.text: Arise! The sun commands you!

easy.text: Hardly a fitting stage for my radiance.

easy2.text: Such a brief performance. Alas.

explore1.text: The sunlight is perfect today. It suits me.

explore2.text: When the gods write their histories, I'll be in chapter one.

gate.text: The gate falls! Then I shall be the wall! Behold!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. But did you see how I shone?

hard2.text: That was a difficult battle. My radiance never dimmed.

held.text: They flee before my light! Millbrook is saved, by me!

hired.text: Millbrook called for a hero. The sun answered!

lair.text: A pit of shadow! Let the light pour in!

levelup.text: I shine brighter! The heavens take notice!

loot.text: Ah, a relic worthy of my glory.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Darkness, meet the dawn.

rest.text: Even the sun must set. We should take a long rest.

start.text: Behold! The sun's champion takes the field!

start2.text: Bask in my glory, monsters, it will be your last sight!

tower.text: A tower crumbles! No matter, I still shine!

town.text: Millbrook! I'm sure they'll want to see me.

villain.text: The villain walks beneath my sun? How bold. And how foolish.

walls.text: Upon the walls I shall shine like a beacon! Behold me!

wave.text: An army of darkness marches! The sun will meet it on the road!

win.text: Dawn breaks over the realm, and I am its light!

boss.text: So you're the villain. You'll make a fine last chorus!

danger.text: Now this is a fight they'll sing about!

down.text: On your feet! Nobody dies before the song is written!

down2.text: Not today, friend! Up! There's more killing to do!

dying.text: Sing it loud... and make me taller in the song...

easy.text: Bah! That wasn't even a warm-up.

easy2.text: Is that all? I've had harder fights over the last ale.

explore1.text: When we're done, every tavern in the north will know my name.

explore2.text: I smell adventure. Or wet dog. Hard to tell.

gate.text: The gate's down! Good! Now they come to me!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. The bards had better get every detail.

hard2.text: Now that's a fight! My arms are shaking, and I love it!

held.text: Ha! Back they run! Millbrook stands, and so do I!

hired.text: A new hero for a new song! The name's Brakka. Remember it!

lair.text: A monster nest! Kick it open and let's see what crawls out!

levelup.text: I feel stronger! Bring me a bigger monster!

loot.text: A fine prize! It will look good in my legend.

march.text: To the Dark Tower! This is the verse they'll remember!

rest.text: Even I need sleep. Let's make camp and take a long rest.

start.text: Ha! Finally, something worth swinging at!

start2.text: Line up, monsters! One at a time or all at once, I don't mind!

tower.text: They knocked down a tower? I'll build it again with their bones!

town.text: Millbrook! Ale, a fire, and an audience.

villain.text: There! The villain, out in the open! Come and fight me!

walls.text: To the walls! Let them climb, I'll knock them down one by one!

wave.text: They're marching on Millbrook? Not past me, they aren't!

win.text: Victory! Sing it loud, sing it forever!

boss.text: You're the big boss? Good. Big boss, big bounty!

danger.text: Oh, this'll cost extra. A lot extra.

down.text: Don't you die on me! You owe me wages!

down2.text: Get up! Dead men don't pay their tab!

easy.text: Easy money. I like easy money.

easy2.text: Quick job. Full price, though.

explore1.text: Short legs, long walks. I'm adding a walking fee.

explore2.text: Anyone else hear coins? I always hear coins.

gate.text: They broke the gate? Who's paying for that? Not me!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle, and I'm billing for every bruise!

hard2.text: That was a difficult battle. My rates just went up.

held.text: They're running! That's a win, and a win costs extra!

hired.text: Heard the last lot didn't make it. So the pay's gone up, right?

lair.text: A monster den! There's always loot in a monster den!

levelup.text: Stronger and fiercer! My rates just went up.

loot.text: Mine! Well, ours. Mostly mine.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Danger pay, triple. Not negotiable.

rest.text: I'm not paid enough to bleed this much. Long rest. Now.

start.text: Right! That's double rate for monsters!

start2.text: Monsters again? Hazard pay, everyone, hazard pay!

tower.text: There goes a tower! Put it on the town's bill!

town.text: Millbrook! Time to collect what I'm owed.

villain.text: Oi! That's the villain! What's the bounty on that one?

walls.text: Wall duty's extra! Double for nights, triple for monsters!

wave.text: Monsters heading for town? Somebody's paying for this. Probably me.

win.text: We won! Now, about my payment...

boss.text: Hear my hymn, villain! It's the last thing you'll hear!

danger.text: Now's the time for the loudest hymn I know!

down.text: Up you get! The hymn's not finished!

down2.text: Up you get! I'm not singing your funeral hymn today!

easy.text: Barely got through the first verse!

easy2.text: Ha! Not even a full chorus!

explore1.text: Did I ever sing you the Ballad of the Iron Psalm? All forty verses?

explore2.text: Fine weather for a hymn! Every weather is fine for a hymn!

gate.text: The gate's broken! Sing louder, lads, and swing harder!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle! My voice is hoarse from all the singing!

hard2.text: My throat's raw and my hammer's dented. A grand fight!

held.text: They're running! A hymn of victory, everyone, from the top!

hired.text: The last party sang their last. Time for a new verse, friends!

lair.text: A nest of wickedness! I'll sing it a hymn it won't forget!

levelup.text: Praise be! My voice grows mightier!

loot.text: A gift from above! Or from a dead goblin. Same thing!

march.text: To the Dark Tower! I've saved my best hymn for this!

rest.text: Even my lungs need a break. A long rest, I say!

start.text: Ha ha! A hymn for battle, friends! Sing with me!

start2.text: A battle! I know just the hymn!

tower.text: There goes a tower! We'll sing it a lament later!

town.text: Millbrook! A choir, a cask, and a warm hearth!

villain.text: Ho there, villain! Care to join us for a hymn? No? Pity!

walls.text: Up the walls, lads! A hymn for every arrow!

wave.text: An army on the march! Then let's give them a marching song!

win.text: Victory! Now that deserves a hymn! All together now!

boss.text: Feel the power of the Grimmbrew Rune!

danger.text: Big trouble. Good. Big trouble makes big legends.

down.text: Get up! Nobody dies in front of the Grimmbrew Rune!

down2.text: Up! My rune of healing never fails! Usually!

dying.text: Carve my name... in the biggest rune...

easy.text: Didn't even need my best rune.

easy2.text: Didn't even scratch the runes.

explore1.text: One day, every smith in the realm will carve the Grimmbrew Rune.

explore2.text: Did you see my rune on that door? No? I'll carve another.

gate.text: The gate's broken? Impossible! I runed that gate myself! Mostly!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Write it down: the Grimmbrew Rune saved us.

hard2.text: That was a difficult battle. I'll be carving bigger runes.

held.text: They're running! My runes held! Well, the ones on the walls did!

hired.text: Heroes wanted? You'll want a runesmith. You'll want the best one.

lair.text: A lair, eh? I'll carve a demolition rune on the front door!

levelup.text: A new rune! The Grimmbrew Rune, Mark Two!

loot.text: Not bad. Could use a rune or two, though.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I'll carve my rune on its doors.

rest.text: My hands are shaking. Time for a long rest and a strong ale.

start.text: Watch the runes, friends! These ones are mine!

start2.text: Stand back and watch real rune work!

tower.text: That tower didn't have my runes on it. Clearly.

town.text: Millbrook! Time to show the smith my latest rune.

villain.text: Is that the villain? Hmph. I've seen better armour on a goat.

walls.text: Hold the walls! I carved runes into every stone! Well, most of them!

wave.text: An army on the road! Time for my Rune of Stopping Armies!

win.text: Victory! It will be known forever as the Grimmbrew Victory!

boss.text: So you're the champion here. Not for long!

danger.text: Big ones. Good. I hate a small crowd.

down.text: Up! Get up! The fight's not over!

down2.text: No sleeping in a fight! Up!

easy.text: That's it? The pit crowd would have thrown cabbages.

easy2.text: Too quick. Grukka wants another.

explore1.text: This whole land is one big arena. I love it.

explore2.text: Walking, walking. When do we hit something?

gate.text: Gate's broken! Fine. More of them in reach!

hard.text: That one hurt. Good fight, though. Good fight.

hard2.text: Ow. Good fight. Very good. Ow.

held.text: They run! Ha! The wall wins. Grukka wins.

hired.text: Grukka heard there was fighting here. Grukka is here.

lair.text: Monster house. I knock on the door. With my maul.

levelup.text: Stronger! I was already strong, and now I'm stronger!

loot.text: Ooh, shiny. I'll wear it into the next fight.

march.text: The Dark Tower. The biggest arena of all.

rest.text: My arms feel like lead. Time for a long rest.

start.text: Ha! Now we're fighting!

start2.text: Lots of them. Good. Grukka was bored.

tower.text: Tower fell over. Grukka didn't. Keep hitting!

town.text: Town! Food first. Then more fighting.

villain.text: Hey! Big villain! Come here and fight!

walls.text: They come to the walls? Good. Easy to find.

wave.text: Big crowd coming! I fight all of them!

win.text: We won! Champions of the whole realm!

boss.text: Your darkness ends here! Every life you took is remembered!

danger.text: Gods protect us. Stay together, all of you.

down.text: No! I won't let you go! Hold on!

down2.text: Stay with me! Look at me! You'll be all right!

dying.text: Don't cry... I'll be with the gods...

easy.text: Thank the gods, no one was badly hurt.

easy2.text: Not a scratch. The gods are kind today.

explore1.text: Every village we pass is another reason to keep going.

explore2.text: Did everyone drink some water? Please drink some water.

gate.text: They've broken the gate! Protect the townsfolk!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Let me see those wounds.

hard2.text: Everyone sit. I'll go one by one.

held.text: They're retreating! Thank the gods, Millbrook is safe!

hired.text: Millbrook needs healers now more than ever. I'm here.

lair.text: Something terrible is made in there. We have to end it.

levelup.text: The light grows brighter in me.

loot.text: A blessing! May it keep you safe.

march.text: The Dark Tower. May the gods walk with us.

rest.text: Everyone's hurt. I think it's time we took a long rest.

start.text: Stay close to me! I'll keep you standing!

start2.text: Stay together! Nobody falls while I'm here!

tower.text: The tower's fallen! Is anyone hurt? Bring them to me!

town.text: Millbrook. Let's see who needs healing.

villain.text: That's the villain... out there in the open. Gods protect us.

walls.text: To the walls! Wounded come to me, everyone else, hold!

wave.text: They're heading for Millbrook! We can't let them reach the children!

win.text: We're alive. We're all alive. Thank the gods.

boss.text: Stand still. I'm about to steal your whole kingdom.

danger.text: Now this is how legends get made.

down.text: Up! You can't die before you see me get famous!

down2.text: Get up! You're missing my best part!

easy.text: Too easy. Nobody will believe I needed help.

easy2.text: Too short! The crowd wanted more!

explore1.text: One day they'll put my face on wanted posters. Big ones.

explore2.text: Do you think they'll name a heist after me?

gate.text: They broke the gate! Perfect! Now everyone can watch me save the day!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Tell me someone saw that last move.

hard2.text: That was a difficult battle. And I was amazing in it.

held.text: They ran! Did you see that? Someone tell the bards!

hired.text: Heard there's a vacancy for heroes. You're welcome, Millbrook!

lair.text: A villain's lair! Now that's a stage worth stealing!

levelup.text: Better and better! My legend grows!

loot.text: Now everyone will know I stole this!

march.text: Robbing the Dark Tower? The heist of the century!

rest.text: Even legends need their sleep. Long rest, everyone.

start.text: Watch this! Somebody write this down!

start2.text: Places, everyone! The show's about to start!

tower.text: A whole tower, gone! Okay, that was almost as good as me.

town.text: Millbrook! I wonder if they've heard of me yet.

villain.text: Look, the villain in the flesh! Someone fetch a painter!

walls.text: On the walls, everyone! Best seats in the house!

wave.text: They're coming for the town? Not before they see my act!

win.text: We did it! Korra Blackgum, savior of the realm!

boss.text: Your magic is crude. Allow me to demonstrate.

danger.text: Interesting. That shouldn't be possible.

down.text: Don't die yet. I haven't finished observing you.

down2.text: Stay alive. My research isn't finished with you.

dying.text: Fascinating... so this is how it feels...

easy.text: Hardly a worthwhile experiment.

easy2.text: Predictable. Disappointingly so.

explore1.text: These ruins hum with old magic. Can you feel it?

explore2.text: I only study it for academic reasons, of course.

gate.text: The gate has fallen. Let them come through. Into the fire.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'll need to revise my theories.

hard2.text: Instructive. Painful, but instructive.

held.text: They retreat. The experiment concludes in our favour.

hired.text: The last heroes fell. I am not them.

lair.text: The villain's workshop. I'd love to see their notes.

levelup.text: New knowledge. Forbidden, naturally.

loot.text: Oh, this is very rare. And very, very dangerous. Perfect.

march.text: The tower's archives must be extraordinary. Let's go.

rest.text: My mana is exhausted. A long rest is required.

start.text: Let's see how they react to something forbidden.

start2.text: Fascinating. Let's see how they burn.

tower.text: A tower lost. A variable I failed to account for.

town.text: Millbrook. Their library is pitiful.

villain.text: The villain, walking the land. Such a waste of power.

walls.text: A siege. Let's see how they like falling fire.

wave.text: They march on Millbrook. I'd like to test something on them.

win.text: Victory. And I've learned so much. Strictly for academic reasons.

move2.text: Long walk. Always a long walk.

ack2.text: I was going there anyway... for you.

dance3.text: One, two, three. One, two, three.

done.text: Done! Can I burn something now?

idle2.text: I'm gonna set something on fire.

summoned.text: Out of the Pit and into the work!

summoned2.text: Imp's here. The party can start.

ack2.text: I was going there anyway! Yes!

build.text: Big nest for the Great One!

summoned2.text: Fresh from the egg, ready to dig!

boss.text: Your defenses are impressive. They're also finished.

danger.text: This is beyond my contract. We hold anyway.

down.text: Man down! Keep pressure on the wound!

down2.text: Stay down, I've got you. Pressure on the wound.

easy.text: Textbook. Exactly as planned.

easy2.text: Efficient. Very efficient.

explore1.text: Third pressure plate this week. Somebody really doesn't like us.

explore2.text: The guild expects results. So do I.

gate.text: Gate breached! Second line, now! Fall back on the hall!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'll be filing a full report.

hard2.text: We need better tactics. And more bandages.

held.text: Enemy retreating. Walls held. Good work, all of you.

hired.text: The guild sent me. The last team missed their deadlines.

lair.text: The villain's lair. Watch for traps. I'll go first.

levelup.text: Improved technique. The guild will be pleased.

loot.text: Excellent workmanship. I'll note it in the inventory.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Every trap in there is mine to disarm.

rest.text: Gear's damaged, morale's low. We take a long rest.

start.text: Formation! Mind your footing, there could be traps.

start2.text: Eyes open. Keep your spacing.

tower.text: We've lost a tower. Close the gap, and quickly!

town.text: Millbrook. Time to restock and check the gear.

villain.text: Target sighted. The villain. Noting the route.

walls.text: Positions! Archers left, the rest of you on the gate!

wave.text: Column on the road. We hit them before they reach the walls.

win.text: Job complete. Best work of my career.

boss.text: Before we begin, could you clarify footnote twelve? No? Fireball, then.

danger.text: Fascinating creature. Deadly, of course. But fascinating.

down.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Someone, ah, do the healing thing!

down2.text: Oh dear! Wake up! I can't remember the healing words!

easy.text: Hmm? Oh, it's over. I was reading.

easy2.text: Oh, finished? I'd only just found my page.

explore1.text: There's a footnote about this valley. Or was it the next valley?

explore2.text: Did I mention the Dark Tower has a library? Footnote twelve.

gate.text: The gate? Broken? Oh dear. Was that the important one?

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Remind me to take notes later.

hard2.text: My, my. I may need a very long sit down.

held.text: Oh, they're leaving! Splendid. Did we win? We won, didn't we?

hired.text: I was told there's an opening for heroes? Ah. I thought it was the library.

lair.text: A lair! I wonder if the villain keeps a library in there.

levelup.text: Ah! A new spell. Now, where did I write it down?

loot.text: Extraordinary! I must study this at once.

march.text: The Dark Tower at last. My footnote awaits!

rest.text: I believe it's time we took a long rest. I've lost my spectacles again.

start.text: Oh! A fight! Er, yes, right. Fireball, was it?

start2.text: Ah, monsters. Now, which spell was the, er, explodey one?

tower.text: Goodness, the tower! I left a book in there!

town.text: Millbrook! I believe I left a book at the inn. Some years ago.

villain.text: Is that the villain? Hmm. Smaller than the illustrations.

walls.text: The walls? Oh, yes, the walls. Which way is the enemy again?

wave.text: An army! Fascinating. Coming here, you say? Oh dear.

win.text: We won! And I finally finished my footnote.

boss.text: So this is what was behind the last door!

danger.text: That's bigger than I expected. Much bigger.

down.text: Wake up, wake up! Don't make me open your eyelids myself!

down2.text: Hey! Hey! Don't you dare stop breathing!

dying.text: Hey... who ate my... last biscuit...

easy.text: Ha! Over before I finished my snack!

easy2.text: Done already? I barely got to stab anything!

explore1.text: I wonder what's behind that door. There's always a door.

explore2.text: If I had a lockpick for every locked chest... oh wait, I do!

gate.text: The gate! They're in! Run, hide, no, fight! Fight!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'd like to lie down for a week.

hard2.text: I'm tired. And sore. And I lost my snack.

held.text: They're running away! We won! Can I have a medal?

hired.text: New in town! Pip Thistledown, at your service. Mind your purses!

lair.text: A secret monster hideout! I bet there's a secret door!

levelup.text: Quicker fingers! Ooh, this is exciting!

loot.text: A secret compartment! I knew it, I just knew it!

march.text: The Dark Tower has a lot of locked doors. I can't wait.

rest.text: My feet hurt, my head hurts, everything hurts. Long rest?

start.text: Ooh, what have they got in their pockets?

start2.text: Ooh, they've got shiny bits! I call dibs!

tower.text: Whoa! That tower just fell right over!

town.text: Millbrook! I've picked every lock here twice.

villain.text: Look, look! The villain! Can I pick their pocket? Just once?

walls.text: Up on the walls! Ooh, you can see everything from up here!

wave.text: A whole army! Do armies carry snacks? Let's find out!

win.text: We won! Can we explore the treasure room now?

boss.text: Your crown's worth a fortune. I'll be needing it.

danger.text: Bad odds. I don't like bad odds.

down.text: Stay with me. Dead partners don't split loot.

down2.text: Come on. You still owe me money.

easy.text: Not even worth the price of the arrows.

easy2.text: Cheap fight. I like a bargain.

explore1.text: Everything has a price. Even this mud.

explore2.text: That old ruin? Worth more than it looks. Trust me.

gate.text: Gate's gone. Fall back to the hall, and nobody touch my stash.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Somebody owes us for that.

hard2.text: That cost us. Somebody's going to pay it back.

held.text: They're leaving. Good. Nobody robs this town but me.

hired.text: The last crew's gone. I'll take the job. And their shares.

lair.text: A lair. Villains always hoard. Let's see the stock.

levelup.text: Sharper eyes, sharper knives. Good for business.

loot.text: Fine work. Worth a small fortune to the right buyer.

march.text: Whatever's in that tower, I'll know its price.

rest.text: We're running on empty. Time we took a long rest.

start.text: Mind the merchandise. I want what they're carrying.

start2.text: Right then. Quick and quiet, and check their pockets after.

tower.text: There goes a tower. That'll cost the town a pretty penny.

town.text: Millbrook. I know a man here who doesn't ask questions.

villain.text: There's the villain. Out in the open. Careless.

walls.text: On the walls, then. Nobody loots this town but me.

wave.text: That lot's after Millbrook. Bad for business. Let's stop them.

win.text: Realm's saved. And our cut? Very generous, I'd say.

boss.text: So you're the end of the road. Show me what you are!

danger.text: I've never seen anything like that. Wonderful. Terrifying.

down.text: No, no! Stay with us! There's still so much to see!

down2.text: Breathe! Please, just keep breathing!

dying.text: The forest... I want to see the forest...

easy.text: Hm. Their kind are less interesting than I hoped.

easy2.text: Over already? But I was just getting started!

explore1.text: The forest never told me the world was this big.

explore2.text: What's past that ridge? I have to know.

gate.text: They're through the gate! Everyone back, back to the hall!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I learned a lot. Mostly about pain.

hard2.text: Everything hurts. But that was amazing.

held.text: We did it! They're running! The town is still ours!

hired.text: Everyone's talking about a villain. I had to see for myself!

lair.text: Something lives in there. Let's find out what!

levelup.text: I feel the wild in me growing stronger!

loot.text: Ooh! What does it do? Can I try it?

march.text: Whatever lives in that tower, I want to see it.

rest.text: Even the wolves rest after a hunt. Let's take a long rest.

start.text: Something new to fight! Let's see what you are!

start2.text: Oh, I've never seen these ones before! Let's find out what they're made of!

tower.text: The tower's falling! Look out below!

town.text: So many people in one place. How do they breathe?

villain.text: Is that the villain? Out walking, like anyone else? Strange!

walls.text: So many of them! Quick, everyone up on the walls!

wave.text: They're all going the same way. Let's get there first!

win.text: We did it! And there's still a whole world past this one!

boss.text: I swore to drive you out, and a dwarf keeps his word!

danger.text: Steady now. This one could be the death of us.

down.text: Hold on, friend! I'll not lose another to the dark!

down2.text: Stay with me! Your ancestors can wait!

dying.text: Tell my clan... I kept my oath...

easy.text: Barely worth the sharpening of my blade.

easy2.text: A small fight. Small fights are good. Fewer graves.

explore1.text: These hills were green once. We'll make them green again.

explore2.text: Keep your eyes open. The dark has eyes too.

gate.text: The gate is breached! Form a wall of steel behind it!

hard.text: That was a hard-fought battle. The hills will remember it.

hard2.text: My oath held. My knees nearly didn't.

held.text: They break against us like the sea on stone. Millbrook holds.

hired.text: The fallen swore an oath. I'll finish it for them.

lair.text: Another of the villain's burrows. We'll bring it down stone by stone.

levelup.text: My oath grows stronger, and so do I.

loot.text: Good dwarven craft, this. It'll serve us well.

march.text: The Dark Tower. My oath ends where it began.

rest.text: We're battered and bleeding. Time we took a long rest.

start.text: For my grandfather's axe! Stand fast!

start2.text: Steady, all. We fight as one, or we fall as one.

tower.text: A tower falls. We'll mourn it after. Hold the line!

town.text: Millbrook still stands. Good. That's why we fight.

villain.text: That's the villain, walking free as you like. Mark the spot.

walls.text: Man the walls! Not one of them sets foot in this town!

wave.text: An army on the road. Then we meet it on the road.

win.text: It's done. Grandfather, rest easy now.

boss.text: Before we fight, can I interest you in a spellbook?

danger.text: This might be the end of me. Spellbook copies, half price, everyone!

down.text: Don't die! Healing scrolls, discount for friends!

down2.text: Don't die! I've got a scroll for that, somewhere!

easy.text: Easy! Want to learn that spell? Very reasonable rates.

easy2.text: Quick sale! Next!

explore1.text: Spellbook copies! Thirty gold! Twenty-five for the party!

explore2.text: Have I told you about my scroll subscription service?

gate.text: The gate's down! Emergency fireball, half price! Today only!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Signed spellbook copies after the rest!

hard2.text: That was a difficult battle. I'm out of stock on everything!

held.text: They're running! Victory! Commemorative scrolls available!

hired.text: Millbrook's hiring heroes? Wonderful! I'll need an advance.

lair.text: A villain's lair! Ooh, think of the salvage rights!

levelup.text: A new spell! The second edition is going to sell so well.

loot.text: Ooh, I know a collector who would pay a fortune for this.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Imagine the souvenir market!

rest.text: Time we took a long rest. I'll set up a little stall.

start.text: Fireballs! Get your fireballs! Free demonstration!

start2.text: Step right up, monsters! Free fireball for the first customer!

tower.text: Lost a tower! Good thing I sell rebuilding charms!

town.text: Millbrook! Prime customers!

villain.text: Look, the villain! Do you think they need a good wizard? Kidding!

walls.text: Wall defence package! Fire, lightning, the works! Discount for the town!

wave.text: An army headed for Millbrook! That's terrible for business!

win.text: We saved the realm! Commemorative scrolls, available now!

boss.text: I offer you mercy once. Only once.

danger.text: Be calm. Fear only feeds the enemy.

down.text: Hold still, friend. I am here.

down2.text: Breathe with me. In. Out.

easy.text: Peace returns. That is enough.

easy2.text: Quickly done. Good.

explore1.text: The road is long, but every step is a lesson.

explore2.text: Listen. Even the wind is saying something.

gate.text: The gate is gone. Then we are the gate.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Sit. Let me tend to you.

hard2.text: Rest now. All of you.

held.text: They retreat. The town breathes. So do we.

hired.text: The others have gone. I will walk the path in their place.

lair.text: A place of suffering. We will end it.

levelup.text: My spirit is steadier. My fists are heavier.

loot.text: A useful thing. Let us use it wisely.

march.text: The Dark Tower waits. We go in peace, and in strength.

rest.text: Our bodies are spent. We should take a long rest.

start.text: Breathe. Focus. Strike.

start2.text: Be still. Then move.

tower.text: The tower falls. We do not.

town.text: Millbrook. There will be sick people here. Let us help them.

villain.text: The villain walks alone. Interesting.

walls.text: Hold the walls. Breathe. Let them come.

wave.text: They march on the town. We meet them first.

win.text: It is over. Now we heal the land.

boss.text: Nice throne. I'll be taking it with me.

danger.text: Oh, darling, this is going to be expensive.

down.text: Get up! I can't carry you, it would ruin my coat.

down2.text: Up, darling. Lying in the mud is so unbecoming.

dying.text: Not like this... I'm wearing silk...

easy.text: Child's play. I've picked harder locks.

easy2.text: Was that the whole show? How disappointing.

explore1.text: Every castle we pass, I'm counting the windows.

explore2.text: Such a dreary countryside. Nothing worth stealing.

gate.text: The gate is down. How tiresome. Everyone, to the hall.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I broke a nail. Two, actually.

hard2.text: I'll need a bath. And a new coat. And a nap.

held.text: And off they scurry. Millbrook survives. Do try to look grateful.

hired.text: I hear there's a dark lord with a very full treasury.

lair.text: A villain's lair. Let's see if they keep anything nice.

levelup.text: Faster, sharper, and still fabulous.

loot.text: Now that is exquisite. I'll take good care of it.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I hear the treasury is enormous.

rest.text: I need a long rest and a hot bath. In that order.

start.text: Let's make this quick. I just had this cleaned.

start2.text: Shall we dance, then? Try to keep up.

tower.text: There goes a tower. I never liked the architecture anyway.

town.text: Millbrook. Quaint. Nothing worth stealing, sadly.

villain.text: Well, well. The villain, out for a stroll. How bold.

walls.text: Defending a wall. How terribly... municipal.

wave.text: They're making for Millbrook. I do hate a crowd.

win.text: We saved the realm. Now, who's paying for dinner?

assault.text: Go, go, go! Smash it all and don't save me any!

assault2.text: Knock on their door, my lovelies. Knock very, very hard.

beaten.text: Ugh. Fine. Back to the tower. This isn't over.

bounty.text: A bounty? On me? I'm flattered.

bounty2.text: They're putting prices on my lairs. I'll put prices on their heads.

breach.text: Their walls are down! Burn everything!

breach2.text: The walls are down! Oh, this is the best part!

breach3.text: Burn it! Burn the bakery! Burn everything!

council.text: Week's over, darlings. Who wants to break a town?

council2.text: They've had their little week of peace. How sweet.

dawn.text: Morning! Who wants to be wicked today?

dawn2.text: The sun's up. Ugh. Let's make it smoke.

dawn3.text: A new day, full of new sins.

deceive.text: Serve me, and you'll walk free once Millbrook falls. You have my word.

deceive2.text: No tricks, I promise. Demons never lie.

deceive3.text: Just one little job, and you're free.

fight.text: Oh, good. I was hoping you'd say no.

heroesgrow.text: The heroes are getting stronger. Good, more fun to break.

hold.text: Let them sweat another week. Anticipation is half the fun.

intimidate.text: Join me, or I'll show you what the Pit does to the stubborn.

intimidate2.text: I have done terrible things to things much bigger than you.

intimidate3.text: Say no. Go on. I'd love that.

intro.text: Ah, a new world to burn. Let's begin.

intro2.text: Fresh air, fresh blood, fresh souls. I love this place already.

lair.text: Another crack in the world. Another door for my children.

lair2.text: A new nest for my little horrors.

lair3.text: Smell that? Brimstone. Home sweet home.

lairlost.text: They broke my toy! Now I'm cross.

lead.text: Oh, I'm coming too. I wouldn't miss this for all the souls in the Pit.

lead2.text: Make way! The Prince is going to the party!

levelup.text: Yes! More! The Pit is pouring into me!

levelup3.text: I can feel the Pit getting closer.

lose.text: Back to the Pit... I'll be back... I always come back...

lose2.text: Fine! Keep your little world! I'll be back!

march.text: They're coming here? Oh, I am going to enjoy this.

march2.text: They're coming to me? I'll put the kettle on. The boiling kind.

minelost.text: They smashed my mine. Petty. I respect it.

newparty.text: New heroes! I hope these ones scream louder.

order2.text: As I like it. I'm off.

parley.text: Well, well. What do we have here? Let's talk.

parley2.text: Hello, monsters. Want to cause some trouble?

parley3.text: I have an offer you'll love.

pay.text: Here, gold. I hear mortals love this stuff.

pay3.text: Here. Don't spend it all on one village.

persuade.text: Just imagine what we could break together.

persuade2.text: Chaos, fire, and all the loot you can carry.

persuade3.text: Join me. It's going to be so much fun.

repelled.text: Turned back? How embarrassing. For them, I mean.

ride.text: I'm going for a walk. Try not to miss me.

ride2.text: Let's go and ruin someone's day.

ride3.text: Out I go. Somebody hide the children.

select2.text: Oh, you want something. How delightful.

select5.text: Bored, bored, bored. Give me something to burn.

spotted.text: Found you, little heroes. Run. It's more fun that way.

spotted3.text: There you are. I've been looking forward to this.

summon.text: Another imp! They grow up so fast.

summon2.text: Come out, little one. Mischief awaits.

talent3.text: I learn so much down here.

throne.text: Welcome to my throne room. Please, scream as loud as you like.

throne2.text: So you made it. Shall we dance?

tower.text: Oops! There goes their tower!

tower2.text: Down it comes! Do it again!

wave.text: Go, my darlings. Go and break their pretty little town.

wave2.text: Off you go. Bring back screams.

wave3.text: Run along and burn something pretty.

win.text: The realm burns. Let the rest of the Pit come through.

win2.text: And the whole world burned. What a lovely ending.

assault.text: Burn it! Burn every timber of that town!

assault2.text: Over the walls, my brood. Bring me their gold.

beaten.text: Enough. My wounds need the warmth of my tower.

beaten2.text: My wings ache. I will return to the hoard and rest.

bounty.text: A bounty on me? I'll take that gold too.

bounty2.text: They offer coin for my lairs. How cute.

breach.text: Their walls crack like eggshells. Burn the town.

breach2.text: Their gates are open. Bring me their gold!

breach3.text: Burn it all. Ash makes a fine carpet.

council.text: The week is spent. My hoard grows impatient. Shall we burn Millbrook?

council2.text: My army smells their fear. Give the word.

dawn.text: The sun rises. It warms my scales.

dawn3.text: Morning. Count the gold. Count it again.

dawn4.text: Dawn. The kingdom wakes beneath my wings.

deceive.text: Join me, and I will share my hoard with you. Of course I will.

deceive2.text: My hoard has room for your share. Truly.

deceive3.text: I only want the town's gold. You may keep the rest.

fight.text: So be it. I was getting hungry anyway.

fight2.text: Good. I prefer my meals to struggle.

heroesgrow2.text: Let them sharpen their little swords.

hold.text: Patience. The fire is sweeter when it waits.

intimidate.text: Kneel before me, or I'll roast you where you stand.

intimidate2.text: I have eaten armies. You are a snack.

intimidate3.text: Bow, or burn. Those are your choices.

intro.text: Wake, my tower. The age of ash begins again.

intro2.text: I have slept long enough. The world has grown fat. Time to feed.

kill.text: Another little hero, turned to ash.

kill3.text: Another hero, another trinket for my hoard.

kill4.text: They always forget I breathe fire.

lair.text: A new den for my brood. All this land is my hoard.

lair2.text: Another nest. My brood grows strong.

lair3.text: A new roost. Let the kingdom see my shadow.

lairlost.text: They burned my nest! I will burn their town for it.

lead.text: I will darken their sky myself. Let them look up.

lead2.text: Stand aside. I will melt their gate.

levelup.text: My fire burns hotter. The sky remembers me.

levelup2.text: My scales harden. My fire grows.

levelup3.text: I remember now what it is to be feared.

march.text: The heroes come to my lair. How generous. They bring their gold with them.

march2.text: They march on my lair with all their gold. How thoughtful.

minelost.text: My mine! My gold! They will pay twice.

minelost2.text: No one steals from the hoard and lives.

newparty.text: More heroes? Excellent. I was getting hungry.

newparty2.text: A fresh batch. With better armour, I hope. For my hoard.

order.text: Where my shadow falls, I rule.

parley.text: Small creatures. Look at me when I speak.

parley2.text: You stand before an ancient dragon. Choose your words.

parley3.text: Small creatures. You may grovel now.

pay.text: Take this gold. A few coins from my endless hoard.

pay2.text: Take it. Gold always comes back to me.

pay3.text: A gift from the hoard. Don't get used to it.

persuade.text: Serve me, and you may eat whatever the fire leaves behind.

persuade2.text: Fly with me and share in the plunder.

persuade3.text: There is gold in Millbrook. More than you can carry.

repelled.text: They held? Then hit harder next time.

repelled2.text: A scratch on their wall. Disappointing.

ride.text: I will spread my wings over this land. Let them look up and tremble.

ride2.text: The sky is mine. Let the land beneath it tremble.

ride3.text: I go to see my kingdom. All of it is mine.

select3.text: I am listening. Be worth it.

select4.text: Hmm? Has someone brought me gold?

spotted.text: I smell heroes. Small, warm, and so very afraid.

spotted2.text: There they are. Little morsels in shiny tin.

spotted3.text: I see them. Their armour gleams like coins.

summon.text: More kobolds. They are so eager to serve.

talent.text: Ancient secrets. I collect those too.

talent2.text: Ah, a new treasure of the mind.

talent3.text: Yes. I grow ever more magnificent.

throne.text: You came all this way to die in my fire? I admire the effort.

throne2.text: Look upon my hoard, heroes. It is the last thing you will see.

tower.text: Their tower crumbles like a burnt log.

wave.text: Fly, march, crawl. Bring me Millbrook in ashes.

wave2.text: Go, and bring back treasure. Leave nothing standing.

wave3.text: Burn the fields on your way. I like the smell.

win.text: The realm burns, and every coin in it is mine.

win2.text: Every crown, every coin, every kingdom. Mine.

assault.text: Take the town. Bring me its dead.

assault2.text: At the gates, my servants. Tear them open.

beaten.text: Enough. I return to my tower. This is not forgotten.

beaten2.text: A setback. I have endured worse. I have endured death.

bounty.text: A price on my servants? How touching.

bounty2.text: Millbrook offers gold for my lairs. Gold will not save them.

breach.text: Their walls are broken. Burn it. Burn all of it.

breach3.text: The gate falls. The graveyard grows.

council.text: The week is done. My army waits at their gates. Shall we knock?

council2.text: The living sleep behind their little wall. Wake them.

dawn.text: Another dawn. How I loathe the sun.

dawn2.text: The living wake. Let them enjoy it while it lasts.

dawn4.text: Day breaks. My patience does not.

deceive.text: Join me, and you will never die. I promise.

deceive2.text: Millbrook is defenceless. An easy feast.

deceive3.text: I need only a few days of your help. Then you are free.

fight.text: Then I will take your bones instead.

fight2.text: Very well. Your corpses will be more obedient.

fight3.text: Die, then. It is not so bad.

heroesgrow.text: The heroes grow stronger. So do worms, before the crow comes.

heroesgrow2.text: Let them train. It changes nothing.

hold.text: Not yet. Let them count the days. Let them dread.

intimidate.text: Serve me, or I will raise your corpses and they will serve me instead.

intimidate2.text: Kneel, or rot where you stand.

intimidate3.text: I have killed better than you. They work for me now.

intro.text: The tower is mine again. Let the living count their days.

intro2.text: Centuries in the dark, and the world forgot me. It will remember.

kill.text: One more soul for my collection.

kill2.text: Rise again, hero. You serve me now.

kill3.text: Death is not the end. Not for my servants.

kill4.text: I will remember your name. No one else will.

lair.text: Another pit for my servants. The land grows darker.

lair2.text: Dig deeper. The earth is full of soldiers.

lairlost.text: They burned my crypt. I will build ten more.

lairlost2.text: Heroes in my halls. They will pay in bone.

lead.text: I will lead them myself. Let Millbrook see death walking.

lead2.text: Open the way. Their king of bones is coming.

levelup.text: My power grows. Death itself bends closer.

levelup2.text: I feel the old strength returning.

levelup3.text: Another seal on the grave is broken.

lose.text: This is not the end. I will return. I always return.

lose2.text: My phylactery is hidden. You have not won.

march.text: So the heroes come at last. Good. I grew tired of waiting.

march2.text: They come to my tower at last. Let them come.

minelost.text: They ruined my mine. Petty little thieves.

minelost2.text: The ore can wait. I have time. They do not.

newparty.text: More heroes? The graveyard has room.

newparty2.text: Fresh bodies march out of the tavern. How convenient.

order2.text: The dead walk where I will.

parley.text: You. Creatures of the wild. Hear me.

parley2.text: The living fear you. I do not.

parley3.text: Come closer. I will not bite. I have no tongue.

pay.text: Gold means nothing to the dead. Take it.

pay2.text: Here. Spend it while you still can.

persuade.text: The living hunt you. Join me, and you will hunt them.

persuade2.text: Serve me, and you need never fear death again.

persuade3.text: Millbrook has meat, gold and graves to fill. Come.

repelled.text: They hold their walls. For now.

repelled2.text: A wave breaks. Another will follow. They always do.

ride.text: I will walk among the living. Let them see what they fear.

ride2.text: The grave cannot hold me, and neither can this tower.

ride3.text: Open the gates. Death goes walking.

select4.text: What would you have of eternity?

select5.text: Be brief. I have outlived kingdoms.

spotted.text: There you are, little heroes. I see you now.

spotted2.text: Warm blood on the road. I can smell it from here.

spotted3.text: Run while your hearts still beat.

summon2.text: Another pair of hands. They need not be warm.

talent2.text: The old rites come back to me.

talent3.text: Yes. That was worth a century of study.

throne.text: Welcome, heroes. Your bones will serve me well.

throne2.text: You walked through my dead to reach me. You will join them.

tower.text: Their tower falls. So will they.

tower2.text: One more stone in my graveyard.

wave.text: Go. March on Millbrook. Fill my graves.

wave2.text: March, my dead. You have nothing left to lose.

wave3.text: Bring me their bones. All of them.

win.text: The realm is a graveyard now. And I am its king.

win2.text: Silence at last. A whole realm of silence.

boss.text: You'll make a very generous donation, villain. Very generous.

danger.text: My, my. Surviving this will need a very generous donation.

down.text: Up you get, dear! You haven't paid your tithe yet!

down2.text: Up, dear! You haven't settled your account!

dying.text: Make sure... the temple gets my savings...

easy.text: There we are. Now, does anyone have spare coin for the temple?

easy2.text: Lovely. Nobody needs healing. That's bad for business.

explore1.text: Such a lovely walk. I do hope we pass a rich merchant.

explore2.text: The temple roof needs mending, you know. Very expensive.

gate.text: Oh, not the gate! Do you know what a gate costs, dearies?

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Healing isn't free, you know, dearies.

hard2.text: Oh, my old bones. Line up, dearies, and have your coin ready.

held.text: There, they're off. Now, about a little donation for the repairs.

hired.text: Such a shame about the last heroes. Now, about my fee...

lair.text: A villain's den. They must have a terrible lot of gold in there.

levelup.text: The gods smile on me! And on my collection plate.

loot.text: Oh, how lovely! The temple will be so grateful.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I hear villains keep a great deal of gold.

rest.text: My old bones are aching. Time for a long rest, dearies.

start.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Mind you don't damage anything valuable.

start2.text: Careful now, dears. Healing costs extra after dark.

tower.text: There goes a tower. The temple will need a collection for that.

town.text: Millbrook! Time to pass the collection plate, dearies.

villain.text: Is that the villain? Somebody ask if they'd like to make a donation.

walls.text: Oh, not the walls again. Those were very expensive.

wave.text: They're going to Millbrook? My collection box is in Millbrook!

win.text: We did it, dearies! The temple thanks you. And so do I.

boss.text: I've seen how this ends, villain. Have you?

danger.text: The bones did not like this one. Not at all.

down.text: Not yet. The bones say it's not your time.

down2.text: Not your time. The bones are very clear on that.

easy.text: The bones said we would win. They were bored too.

easy2.text: The bones yawned through that one.

explore1.text: Every bone tells a story. Most of them end badly.

explore2.text: I cast the bones this morning. They wouldn't tell me the ending.

gate.text: The bones said the gate would fall. Now they say run to the hall.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. The bones were right again.

hard2.text: The bones warned me. I should listen more.

held.text: They flee. The bones are pleased. So am I.

hired.text: The bones told me the old heroes would fall. And that I'd come.

lair.text: The bones rattle near this place. Something dark is born in there.

levelup.text: The bones speak more clearly now.

loot.text: Ah. The bones mentioned this.

march.text: The Dark Tower. The bones say this is the end. Of what, they won't say.

rest.text: The bones say rest. A long rest. Who am I to argue?

start.text: The bones said this would happen.

start2.text: The bones say fight. So, we fight.

tower.text: A tower falls. The bones saw that coming too.

town.text: Millbrook. The bones say nothing happens here. I hope they're right.

villain.text: The villain walks the land. The bones have gone very quiet.

walls.text: The bones said they'd come to the walls tonight. I hate being right.

wave.text: An army on the road. The bones say we meet it before Millbrook does.

win.text: So that's how it ends. I always wanted to know.
